notes: Significance is judged by non-overlap of 95% CIs (CI overlap rule), so no test is recorded. Comparisons with MTF and YRBS are discussed but not performed.
view_issues: The text says CIs were used 'at the pless than 0.05 level', a rendering artifact for 'p<0.05'. Table 1 CIs are given as ± half-widths.
